method.method_draft: Inspect the five numbered drawings and compare the mushroom’s overall size above the grass: photo 2 shows the smallest mushroom, photo 5 is slightly larger, photo 3 is taller and has a larger cap, photo 1 is larger still with a wider cap and taller stem, and photo 4 is the largest/tallest mushroom. Use the text statement that the mushroom grows up every day, so the correct chronological order is from smallest to largest. Therefore the sequence is 2-5-3-1-4.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中有五张带编号的蘑菇图画，当前从左到右编号为1、2、3、4、5。比较草丛上方蘑菇的整体高度和菌盖大小：2号最小；5号比2号略大；3号更高且菌盖更大；1号再大一些，茎更高、菌盖更宽；4号最高最大。推理：题目说明蘑菇每天都在长大，所以正确的照片顺序应从最小到最大排列。因此顺序是2-5-3-1-4。
